column3: MT 6:46. NASB supplies “were given,” and “which remained” as “the rest of.” The Hebrew is elliptical.
MT 6:50. “Which they called by names” is rendered “which are mentioned by name.”
MT 6:62. NASB supplies “the Levites,” and does not add “Jokneam” and “Kartah,” which the packet marks as Septuagint additions.
